outcome: feeding type (breast milk or mixed milk) at 1 month of age
breastfeeding rates at 1 month of age
cohort: This study included 176 healthy mothers and their full-term newborns in Japan.
finding: Newborns' effective and sustained sucking within 1 day of birth is an important factor for breastfeeding at 1 month of age, with different maternal and neonatal factors being critical for primiparas and multiparas, respectively.
mod_finding: Primiparas who did not receive epidural analgesia or synthetic oxytocin were more likely to breastfeed at 1 month of age.
